newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM - MAY 08.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM - MAY 08.

text.p: * Belgian Prime Minister Jean Luc Dehaene arrived in Bucharest and is meeting Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea. He will also meet President Emil Constantinescu and the chairmen of parliament's two chambers.
Dehaene will also discuss with Romanian businessmen.
* The lower house, the Chamber of Deputies, will debate a bill on land ownership and leasing under emergency procedures.
Under the bill, a family can purchase up to 200 hectares of land. Foreign citizens cannot own land, but Romanian citizens leaving abroad will be allowed to purchase land.

* The main opposition Party of Social Democracy will file a motion in parliament to protest against a recent government decision to set up a road tax, saying it victimised motorists and impeded free circulation.

* World Bank president James Wolfensohn is expected on a visit to Bucharest on Sunday to discuss the bank's support for Romanian reforms. He will meet the prime minister, the reform and finance ministers
* Ciorbea will head a delegation to Luxembourg on a two-day visit starting on Friday.
